text:
The photo shows a turkey wrap cut in half with lettuce, tomato and carrot, plus a glass of dark soda, probably cola.

Wrap: about 350 kcal. A large tortilla is roughly 150-200 kcal, and the turkey, veggies and some dressing add about 150-200 kcal.
Cola: about 12 oz, or roughly 140 kcal. It could be diet cola, which would be 0 kcal. The glass looks about 3/4 full of a dark liquid, so I'll assume regular cola at about 120 kcal.

Served total: 350 + 120 = 470 kcal.

I can't tell from a before-eating photo how much will be left over, so I'll assume nothing is left. That puts the eaten amount at 470 kcal.

Macronutrients for the wrap: protein about 20 g, carbs about 38 g, fat about 12 g.
Macronutrients for the cola: carbs about 31 g.
Eaten totals: protein 20 g, carbs 69 g, fat 12 g.
